name: vision_diagnostic_acceptance_v1
purpose: Predeclared, preparation-only acceptance contract for a bounded vision diagnostic. It requires matched generated-answer improvement, explicit causal image controls, paired text retention and a candidate-bound fresh-process reload before a diagnostic can be called accepted. It is not a native launch authorization or a promotion decision.

roles.baseline: pre-update report containing the same answer cases and score schema
roles.candidate: post-update report containing generated answers, control provenance and text retention
roles.reload: separate fresh-process zero-update reload receipt bound to the candidate report digest

limitations: This is a CPU report validator, not a native training or generation run.
A passing assessment is bounded diagnostic evidence only; it is not generalization, calibrated confidence, visual competence or promotion.
Existing reports without a pre-update baseline, explicit control provenance or the required reload fields remain inconclusive; no field is inferred to make them pass.
The validator does not authorize development, held-out labels, encoder co-adaptation, retries or a new native job.
